releaseNotes:
Official Update v1.3.11:
- The software now ships completely clean: no products, no departments, no business name and no customer data.
- Business type is now a multi-select in the first-run wizard (restaurant, taco truck, bakery, store, cafe, bar). Each selected type creates its own default departments; types can be mixed and more can be added later in Settings. Products are never preloaded.
- Removed all customer-specific leftovers: hardcoded business names, hardcoded license keys, demo databases, sample menus and test photos.
- Each new installation now gets its own machine ID and trial period (the shipped database no longer carries a shared ID).
- Cake ticket header and waiting list now use your own business name, address and phone from Settings.
- FAQ, website bot and software chatbot include a guide for business types and default departments.
- Includes v1.3.10 and v1.3.9 changes.
